knobs.note: Read by bin/heartbeat-reaper.sh as ${HB_BOOT_AT:-}. Registered by BH-1165 so it is visible; NOT settable from the control plane — it is a command, a host, a path, an identity or a test seam a root lane uses, so only env/global.env on the box moves it; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.
Read by bin/heartbeat-reaper.sh as ${HB_RESTART_PER_HOUR:-3}. Registered by BH-1165 so it is visible and settable; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

Fallback for this box's own name when state/box-name is absent. Read by bin/heartbeat-reaper.sh as ${BOX_NAME:-}. Registered by BH-1165 so it is visible; NOT settable from the control plane — it is a command, a host, a path, an identity or a test seam a root lane uses, so only env/global.env on the box moves it; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

Silence floor for the lane heartbeat: a live lane is called silent only past max(interval x HB_STALE_MULT, this). 0 = off (the pre-BH-4717 arithmetic). Read by bin/lib/heartbeat.sh hb_state as ${HB_SILENT_FLOOR_S:-120}; the reaper puts the settings row in the environment via lane_env_apply, env/global.env is the fallback.

A live lane is silent past interval x this (never under HB_SILENT_FLOOR_S). Read by bin/lib/heartbeat.sh hb_state as ${HB_STALE_MULT:-3}; the reaper puts the settings row in the environment via lane_env_apply, env/global.env is the fallback.
